thread:
Nora Hale: Weekend mini-launch metrics in. Organic post did well, but activation after signup is the choke. We should pick two low-friction experiments: change CTA to trial credits + add a short demo clip in the signup modal.

Ben Ortiz: Numbers snapshot: post CTR 7.9%, signup conversion 4.2%, activation of signups 19%. Biggest drop at first prompt attempt.

Kara Wells: Proposal: A/B hero CTA: (A) RSVP webinar vs (B) Claim 75 trial credits. Also include a 20s product demo autoplay (muted) in the modal for variant B.

Ishaan Mehta: Routing note: if domain matches enterprise list OR company_size>100, send registrant webhook to SalesOps. Otherwise self-serve. Also add engagement_score event.

AnalyticsBot: Quick experiment report (18h):
```
ArmA (RSVP): 9,101 impressions -> 671 clicks (7.37%) -> 184 signups -> 35 activations
ArmB (75 credits + demo): 9,214 impressions -> 702 clicks (7.62%) -> 243 signups -> 88 activations
Activation rate lift ArmB vs ArmA: +18.4pp (p=0.008)
Video watch >15s correlates with activation 66% of the time
```

Nora Hale: Clear winner ArmB. Actions: Ben swap CTA & ad creative (today). Kara produce demo clip + thumbnail (end of day). Ishaan implement routing/webhook + add events: onboarding_demo_view, engagement_score (this sprint).

Kara Wells: We'll canary templates carousel in post-signup modal at 5% to avoid confusing users. Track template_carousel_shown and template_applied.

Ben Ortiz: I'll also add a short in-app nudge on onboarding: "Try a starter template: one-line PR summary. Claim 75 credits." Low lift and measurable.

Nora Hale: Great. Recheck numbers Wed AM and decide on full roll. :rocket:
